claims.citation: Newfoundland Express (St John's), 28 May 1866, p. 2 (Memorial University DAI)

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Scotia (Br.), Judkins, Liverpool 2d, via Queenstown 3d[?]
inst., 8:40 p. m., with mdse. and pass. to E. Cunard. 2d inst., off
Crosby Lightship, passed ship Jeremiah Thompson, hence, bound in;
3d, off Queenstown, steamship Tarifa, bound in; 4th, lat. 51 08, long.
14 55, steamship City of New-York, hence for Liverpool; 5th, lat. 50
48, long. 21 40, a National Co.'s steamer, bound E; same day, steam-
ship City of Limerick, hence for Liverpool; 6th, lat. 48 44, long. 32 53,
a steamer, supposed the Tripoli, hence for Liverpool.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 11 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
